content: iOS: Share menu then Add to Home Screen works for ANY website (Apple support), no manifest strictly needed but manifest + apple-touch-icon control the icon and name. iOS 16.4+ can install PWAs from the Share menu in any mobile browser (MDN). iOS 26 converts any website into a PWA app from the home screen icon. Caveat: iOS 17.4 EU beta reportedly disabled browser PWA installs (DMA), status uncertain as of 2026 - treat standalone app install on iOS as best-effort, home-screen shortcut as guaranteed.
